rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a specifically Christian apostle, especially an early Church leader.

example.english: Paul was an important apostle in the early Church.
example.traditional: 保祿係早期教會一位重要嘅使徒。
example.jyutping: bou2 luk6 hai6 zou2 kei4 gaau3 wui2 jat1 wai6 zung6 jiu3 ge3 si3 tou4

rows.note: Use this for a missionary in general, rather than the specific title of an early Christian apostle.

example.english: That missionary was an apostle who preached in Africa and helped local people set up schools.
example.traditional: 嗰位傳教士去非洲傳教，仲幫當地人辦學。
example.jyutping: go2 wai6 cyun4 gaau3 si6 heoi3 fei1 zau1 cyun4 gaau3 zung6 bong1 dong1 dei6 jan4 baan6 hok6

rows.note: Use this for the pioneer or early-advocate sense, not for the Christian religious title.

example.english: They were an apostle of environmental education.
example.traditional: 佢係推動環保教育嘅先驅。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 teoi1 dung6 waan4 bou2 gaau3 juk6 ge3 sin1 keoi1
